lines.say: You opened the penthouse door at nine oh one. It was you.
Same face. But older. Tired. Holding a wet contract.
He whispers. Never sign page two. Page two is the renewal.
You read it. Winners stay forever. They just get a new face every year.
Then you see the signature at the bottom. Yours. In your handwriting. Dated tomorrow.
Would you sign page two? Write it in the comments.
